title: Hackstore extension manifest
description: A Hackstore extension's manifest.json: a PluginManifest declaring one or more tools, each gated by a closed set of capabilities. Mirrors validatePluginManifest in @0sec/core (packages/core/src/plugins/manifest.ts). Themes and config artifacts use a different shape and are out of scope for this schema.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this JSON Schema, so an editor's language server offers completion and validation.

kind.description: Optional. When present must be "tool"; a tool manifest is the default when omitted. Theme/config artifacts (kind "theme"/"config") are validated by a different shape and rejected by validatePluginManifest.

id.description: Namespaced identifier, e.g. "acme.sqli-pack". Lowercase, dotted/hyphenated. Never reaches the model prompt or a dispatch key.

version.description: Semver-like MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with an optional -prerelease / +build tail.

minCoreVersion.description: Optional minimum @0sec/core version this extension requires.

tools.description: The tools this extension contributes. At least one, at most 64.

capability.description: A capability from the closed set. Each maps onto a concrete authorization gate the console already enforces for built-in tools.

name.description: Dispatch key + prompt-facing + UI-facing tool name. Lowercase ASCII letters, digits and underscore, not starting with a digit. Must not be __proto__/prototype/constructor, and must not collide with a built-in tool name.

description.description: What the tool does. Shown to the model and the operator.

parameters.description: A JSON-schema-ish properties bag (a map of parameter name to a schema object or boolean), passed through to the tool definition. This is a properties bag, not a complete JSON Schema.

required.description: Optional list of parameter names that are required.

capabilities.description: MANDATORY and non-empty. Declares what the tool actually does; drives the authorization gates. "No capabilities" is not expressible.
